root_cause: MDR fee incorrectly applied to RuPay credit UPI transactions that should be fee‑free.
diagnosis: The gateway/acquirer fee configuration is charging a non‑zero MDR on RuPay credit UPI, resulting in a systematic overcharge across all sampled transactions.
action_rationale: Auditing the fee configuration will identify and correct the misapplied MDR, stopping future overcharges.
